exact: negative regulation by symbiont of host phytoalexin production
suppression by symbiont of host phytoalexin production

definition: A process in which a symbiont inhibits or disrupts the production of phytoalexins in the host organism. Phytoalexins are produced by plants to fight against pathogens. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host phytoalexin production
